cues: He said me: say needs to, so said to me, or told me.
He told to me: tell takes no to.
He asked me that where: never that before a wh word.
He asked where was I going: statement order, where I was going.
He asked if I am free, with a question mark: was, and a full stop.
And he said he will come: after a past reporting verb, would.
